flags.description: Oatly's 2020 acceptance of a $200 million investment from Blackstone (alongside celebrity co-investors) triggered a consumer boycott after Blackstone was reported to be a part-owner of two Brazilian firms linked to Amazon deforestation; the deforestation link is to Oatly's investor, not to Oatly's own operations, which Oatly has publicly defended.

Independently verified lifecycle assessments show Oatly's oat drink produces significantly lower greenhouse gas emissions per litre than cow's milk; Oatly prints the carbon footprint directly on product packaging to enable consumers to compare environmental impact at the point of purchase.
